parsed.notes: Lens A review found one high quote-fidelity defect in the stored pin-469 quote and two minor quote-fidelity typography defects. Treatment was recorded only against disclosed lake fields, without a Lens A currency finding.

reasons: The lake record is verified for Cone v. Bell, Warden, U.S. Supreme Court, decided 2009-04-28, docket 07-1114.
The lake citations list official cite 556 U.S. 449 and parallels 129 S. Ct. 1769, 173 L. Ed. 2d 701, and 2009 U.S. LEXIS 3298; the content page uses the same citation/court/year.

defect.evidence_quote:
when the State withholds from a crimi
nal defendant evidence that is material to his guilt or
punishment, it violates his right to due process of law in
violation of the Fourteenth Amendment.
defect.locator_note: text/Cone v. Bell__2943b4.txt, slip opinion page 20; lake pinpoints[] currently has page=null and quote_fidelity=mismatch.
defect.problem: The disclosed pin-469 quote is not a character-faithful opinion quote. It is page prose spanning Background/Issue/Rule headings, not text from Cone v. Bell.
defect.proposed_fix: Replace pin-469 with the actual opinion passage beginning "when the State withholds..." or otherwise align the lake pinpoint with the visible content-page quote.

reasons: The payload quote contains Markdown headings and content-page narrative, which do not appear in the opinion text as a quotation.
The underlying rule is supported, but this stored pinpoint quote is not faithful to the disclosed opinion text.
residual_risks: Official U.S. page 469 cannot be independently checked from the slip-only cached text.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the rule but store the actual opinion sentence as the pin quote; keep slip-only status unless official pagination evidence is added.

defect.evidence_quote:
the obligation to disclose evidence favorable to the defense may
arise more broadly under a prosecutor’s ethical or statutory obligations.
defect.locator_note: text/Cone v. Bell__2943b4.txt, footnote 15, slip opinion page 21.
defect.problem: The quoted words are supported, but the quote is not character-faithful because the content/lake text uses straight "prosecutor's" while the opinion text uses curly "prosecutor’s".
defect.proposed_fix: Use the exact text: "the obligation to disclose evidence favorable to the defense may arise more broadly under a prosecutor’s ethical or statutory obligations."

reasons: The substance and location are supported by footnote 15.
Only the apostrophe typography prevents strict character fidelity.
residual_risks: Official U.S. page 470 n.15 cannot be independently checked from the slip-only cached text.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Normalize curly punctuation against the opinion text, or document that quote-fidelity allows typographic normalization.

defect.evidence_quote:
evidence is “material” within the meaning of Brady when
there is a reasonable probability that, had the evidence
been disclosed, the result of the proceeding would have
been different.
defect.locator_note: text/Cone v. Bell__2943b4.txt, slip opinion page 20.
defect.problem: The quoted material is supported, but it is not character-faithful: the opinion uses curly quotation marks around “material” and plain Brady in the text cache, while the content/lake quote uses straight single quotes and Markdown *Brady*.
defect.proposed_fix: Use the disclosed text form: "evidence is “material” within the meaning of Brady when there is a reasonable probability that, had the evidence been disclosed, the result of the proceeding would have been different."

reasons: The Bagley materiality sentence appears in the disclosed opinion text.
Strict quote fidelity fails only on typography/Markdown styling, not on the legal proposition.
residual_risks: Official U.S. page 470 cannot be independently checked from the slip-only cached text.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use exact quotation marks from the source text, or expressly treat Markdown case-name italics and quote-style normalization as non-fidelity changes.

reasons: The treatment payload matches the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity=good_law, as_of_content=2009-04-28, as_of_treatment=2026-06-30, varies_by_point=false, and the same scope note.
Treatment/currency is outside Lens A, so no independent treatment finding is raised.
residual_risks: Treatment currency left to Lens B.
